pages.text: 早上起来，天灰灰的，风呼呼地吹，窗外的树摇来摇去。
pages.text_en: When Bubu woke up, the sky was grey. The wind was blowing hard, and the trees outside were swaying back and forth.

pages.text: 妈妈说：“今天不能去幼儿园了，台风‘红霞’要来深圳了。”咘咘好奇地问：“台风是什么呀？”
pages.text_en: Mama said, "You can't go to school today. Typhoon Hongxia is coming to Shenzhen!" Bubu asked curiously, "What's a typhoon?"

pages.text: NOMI打开一本图画书给咘咘看：“你知道吗？台风是从海面上生出来的！温暖的海水蒸发到天上，变成很多很多的云，它们转啊转，越转越快，就变成了一个大大的旋转风！”
pages.text_en: NOMI opened a picture book and showed Bubu: "Did you know? Typhoons are born over the ocean! Warm seawater rises into the sky and becomes lots of clouds. They spin and spin, faster and faster, until they become a big swirling wind!"

pages.text: Coco从隔壁来串门：“Bubu! The typhoon has a name! 叫红霞！每个台风都有自己的名字哦！”
pages.text_en: Coco came over from next door: "Bubu! The typhoon has a name! It's called Hongxia! Every typhoon has its own name!"

pages.text: NONO趴在窗台上看外面的风：“叽叽！树都在跳舞！”咘咘看到树被吹得东倒西歪，有些小树叶飞到了天上。
pages.text_en: NONO perched on the windowsill watching the wind: "Chirp chirp! The trees are dancing!" Bubu could see the trees bending in all directions, with little leaves flying up into the sky.

pages.text: 咘咘问：“台风来了会怎样呀？”NOMI说：“会有很大很大的风和很多很多的雨。有时候会把树吹倒，把广告牌吹掉，路上会有积水，所以我们不能出门。”
pages.text_en: Bubu asked, "What happens when a typhoon comes?" NOMI said, "There will be very strong wind and lots of rain. Sometimes it blows down trees and signs, and the roads get flooded, so we can't go outside."

pages.text: 妈妈和奶奶在家做准备：检查窗户关好没有、准备好水和零食。咘咘也帮忙把阳台上的小花盆搬进来：“小花花，进来吧，外面太危险了！”
pages.text_en: Mama and Grandma were getting ready: checking that windows were shut tight, preparing water and snacks. Bubu helped bring the little flower pots in from the balcony: "Come inside, little flowers! It's too dangerous out there!"

pages.text: 外面风雨越来越大——雨点像小豆子一样噼里啪啦打在窗户上。咘咘和Coco趴在窗边看，数雨滴：“One, two, three... 太多了数不过来！”
pages.text_en: The wind and rain got stronger — raindrops pattered against the window like little beans. Bubu and Coco pressed their faces to the glass, counting drops: "One, two, three... too many to count!"

pages.text: NOMI问咘咘：“你还记得刚才学的吗？台风天我们应该怎么做？”咘咘掰着手指头说：“第一，不出门！第二，关好窗户！第三，准备水和食物！”NOMI竖起大拇指。
pages.text_en: NOMI asked Bubu, "Do you remember what we learned? What should we do during a typhoon?" Bubu counted on her fingers: "First, stay inside! Second, close the windows! Third, prepare water and food!" NOMI gave a thumbs up.

pages.text: Coco说：“My mom says typhoon will pass! 台风会走的！”NOMI补充：“对呀，台风只是路过，它会去别的地方。”
pages.text_en: Coco said, "My mom says the typhoon will pass!" NOMI added, "That's right, the typhoon is just passing through. It will move on to somewhere else."

pages.text: 下午，风渐渐小了，雨也变细了。咘咘跑到窗边：“台风走了吗？”妈妈说：“快走了，明天就会放晴啦。”
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, the wind slowly died down and the rain became lighter. Bubu ran to the window: "Is the typhoon gone?" Mama said, "Almost! Tomorrow will be sunny!"

pages.text: 第二天早上——阳光出来了！天蓝蓝的，空气特别新鲜。地上有树叶和小水坑。咘咘穿上雨靴出去踩水坑：“哗啦哗啦！”
pages.text_en: The next morning — the sun was out! The sky was bright blue and the air smelled so fresh. There were leaves and little puddles on the ground. Bubu put on her rain boots and went out to splash: "Splash splash!"

pages.text: 咘咘抬头看天，说：“台风虽然很大很吓人，但是我知道它是怎么来的了，我也知道怎么保护自己了！”NOMI在旁边笑着说：“咘咘现在是台风小专家了！”
pages.text_en: Bubu looked up at the sky and said, "Typhoons are big and scary, but now I know where they come from and how to stay safe!" NOMI smiled beside her: "Bubu is a little typhoon expert now!"
